metadata.title: Role Assignment UI - Tenant-role matrix for user permissions

story.iWant: a user-friendly interface to assign and revoke user roles across tenants
story.soThat: I can manage user permissions efficiently without using API tools
story.tasks: 14 major tasks, 108 subtasks total: - Create role types and API client (lib/types/role.ts, lib/api/roles.ts) - Create React Query hooks (useUserRoles, useAssignRole, useRemoveRole, useAvailableRoles) - Create RoleAssignmentModal component with Headless UI Dialog - Implement CurrentAssignmentsTable (fetch, display, loading/error/empty states, remove button) - Implement AssignRoleForm (tenant dropdown with scoping, role dropdown, validation, mutation) - Implement RemoveRoleDialog with confirmation - Implement optimistic UI updates with rollback (onMutate, onSuccess, onError) - Add "Manage Roles" button to Users table with RBAC visibility - Implement mobile responsive design (cards < 768px, table ≥ 768px) - Implement loading/error states (skeletons, spinners, error banners, retry) - Write unit tests (RTL for all components) - Write integration tests (MSW for API mocking) - Add Storybook stories (all components, dark mode) - Update documentation (user guide, troubleshooting)

acceptanceCriteria.ac: - "Manage Roles" button appears in each user row (glassmorphic Button component) - Button visible only for users with super_admin or tenant_admin role - Clicking button opens Role Assignment Modal - Mobile: Button icon-only (Shield icon) to save space - RBAC: super_admin sees button for all users, tenant_admin only for users in their tenant

- Modal with header (user name/email, close button) - Current Assignments table: Tenant Name, Role badge (color-coded), Remove button - Assign New Role form: Tenant dropdown (searchable), Role dropdown (5 roles with descriptions), Assign button - Footer with Close button - Uses Headless UI Dialog component (accessible, keyboard nav, ESC to close) - Glassmorphic design (.glass-card class)

- API: GET /api/v1/users/{user_id}/roles on modal open - Use React Query useQuery with key ['userRoles', user_id] - Loading state: 3 skeleton rows in table - Error state: Error banner with retry button

- API: POST /api/v1/users/{user_id}/roles with {tenant_id, role} - Use React Query useMutation - On success: Invalidate ['userRoles', user_id] query, show green toast, reset form - Optimistic update: Add row immediately, rollback if error - Error responses: 400 (duplicate), 403 (forbidden), 404 (not found)

- Confirmation dialog with Headless UI Dialog - API: DELETE /api/v1/users/{user_id}/roles/{role_id} - Use React Query useMutation - On success: Invalidate query, show green toast - Optimistic update: Remove row immediately, rollback if error - Last super_admin protection: 400 error shows toast, do not remove row
- tenant_admin: Dropdown disabled, pre-selected with default_tenant_id - super_admin: Dropdown enabled, searchable (Headless UI Combobox), fetches all tenants from GET /api/v1/tenants

- API: GET /api/v1/roles (returns 5 roles with display_name, description, level) - Dropdown shows: "{display_name} - {description}" for each option - Sorted by level (super_admin first, viewer last) - Uses Headless UI Listbox

- Assign: Immediate UI update (add row with spinner) before API confirmation - Remove: Immediate UI update (remove row with fade-out) before API confirmation - Success: Replace/keep optimistic change, show toast - Error: Rollback to previous state (re-add/remove row), show error toast

- Mobile (<768px): Full-screen modal, card-based list, vertical stack - Desktop (≥768px): 600px modal, table layout, horizontal form - Tailwind classes: md:table, md:flex-row, sm:max-w-lg md:max-w-2xl
- Loading: Skeleton rows (3), spinner on buttons, disabled form - Error: Error banner with retry, error toasts with API messages - Empty: "No role assignments yet" message with Shield icon

doc.title: Next.js Feature Parity Epic - Story 3.5: Role Assignment UI
doc.snippet: As a super_admin or tenant_admin, I want to assign and revoke user roles via the UI. Modal opens with tenant selector dropdown, role selector dropdown. RBAC: super_admin can assign any role for any tenant, tenant_admin can only assign roles for own tenant. Special case: Cannot remove last super_admin.

doc.title: Backend Role Assignment API (Prerequisite Story)
doc.snippet: Backend APIs ready: POST /api/v1/users/{user_id}/roles (assign role, 201 Created), DELETE /api/v1/users/{user_id}/roles/{role_id} (revoke role, 204 No Content), GET /api/v1/users/{user_id}/roles (list roles with tenant_name joined), GET /api/v1/roles (5 roles with metadata). Critical: UserTenantRole.tenant_id is VARCHAR (not UUID), must match TenantConfig.tenant_id field. RBAC enforced via JWT, tenant_admin scoped to own tenant only.

doc.title: Next.js UI Migration Epic - Story 2 Component Patterns
doc.snippet: Use Headless UI for accessible components (Dialog, Listbox, Combobox). Glassmorphic design with .glass-card class for modals. React Query for server state with optimistic updates. React Hook Form + Zod for form validation. Lucide React for icons (tree-shakable). Framer Motion for animations.

doc.title: System Architecture - Authentication & Authorization
doc.snippet: Multi-tenant RBAC with 5 roles: super_admin (full system access), tenant_admin (full access within tenant), developer (create agents/prompts/tools), operator (view metrics, execute agents), viewer (read-only). Row-level security in PostgreSQL enforces tenant isolation. JWT tokens contain user_id, tenant_id, role for authorization.

doc.title: Users Management List Page (Existing UI to Extend)
doc.snippet: Existing Users table at nextjs-ui/app/dashboard/users/page.tsx with filters, search, pagination. Uses glassmorphic Button component from src/components/ui/Button.tsx. RBAC patterns: super_admin sees all users, tenant_admin sees only their tenant's users. Extend this table with "Manage Roles" button in action column.

artifact.reason: Existing Users list page where "Manage Roles" button will be added to table action column. Demonstrates RBAC patterns (super_admin vs tenant_admin visibility), table structure, filter/search/pagination patterns.

artifact.symbol: RoleEnum type (line 13), UserDetail interface (lines 27-38), usersApi object
artifact.reason: Existing types and API client for users. Defines RoleEnum matching backend. This file will be extended with role-specific API functions (fetchUserRoles, assignRole, removeRole)

Existing React Query patterns for user management. Demonstrates query key structure, optimistic updates with onMutate/onError/onSettled callbacks, error handling with toast. New hooks (useUserRoles, useAssignRole, useRemoveRole) will follow same patterns.
Glassmorphic button component with variants (primary, secondary, ghost, danger), sizes (sm, md, lg), loading states. Used for "Manage Roles", "Assign", "Remove", "Close" buttons per AC-1, AC-2.

Backend API endpoints that this UI will consume. Defines request/response contracts, RBAC authorization logic (super_admin vs tenant_admin), error responses (400 duplicate, 403 forbidden, 404 not found), tenant scoping, last super_admin protection.

node.usage: Dialog (modal), Listbox (role dropdown), Combobox (tenant dropdown with search)

dependencies.usage: useQuery (fetch user roles, available roles), useMutation (assign/remove with optimistic updates)
Form state management for Assign Role form
Schema validation for role assignment form (tenant_id required UUID, role required RoleEnum)
Icons: Shield (Manage Roles button), Trash2 (Remove button), X (Close button)
AnimatePresence for smooth row add/remove transitions in Current Assignments table
Toast notifications for success/error messages (assign/remove actions)

story-context.constraints: - Must use Headless UI components (Dialog, Listbox, Combobox) for accessibility (AC-2, AC-6, AC-7) - Glassmorphic design: All modals use .glass-card class for backdrop-filter transparency (AC-2) - React Query required: useQuery for fetching, useMutation for mutations with optimistic updates (AC-3, AC-4, AC-5, AC-8) - Optimistic updates mandatory: onMutate (add/remove row), onSuccess (invalidate query), onError (rollback with snapshot) (AC-8) - React Hook Form + Zod required for form validation (AC-4) - RBAC visibility: "Manage Roles" button shows only for super_admin/tenant_admin (AC-1) - Tenant scoping: tenant_admin sees only own tenant in dropdown (disabled, pre-selected), super_admin sees all tenants (AC-6) - Critical data type: tenant_id is VARCHAR (not UUID) in UserTenantRole table - must pass tenant.tenant_id (not tenant.id) to API (from Story 25 learnings) - Last super_admin protection: Cannot remove last super_admin role - show error toast if API returns 400 (AC-5) - Mobile responsive: Cards < 768px, table ≥ 768px (AC-9) - Error handling: All API errors show toast with backend error message or generic fallback (AC-10) - No new page routes: Modal opens on current Users page, no navigation (AC-1, AC-2) - Code reuse: Extend existing nextjs-ui/lib/api/users.ts and nextjs-ui/lib/hooks/useUsers.ts, do not create duplicate files

api.name: POST /api/v1/users/{user_id}/roles
api.description: Assign role to user for specific tenant
api.response: 201 Created: {id, user_id, tenant_id, tenant_name, role, created_at, created_by}
api.errors: 400 (duplicate/user not found/tenant not found), 403 (tenant_admin for other tenant), 401 (unauthorized)

api.name: DELETE /api/v1/users/{user_id}/roles/{role_id}
api.errors: 400 (last super_admin), 403 (tenant_admin for other tenant), 404 (role not found), 401 (unauthorized)

api.name: GET /api/v1/users/{user_id}/roles
api.description: List user's role assignments with tenant names
api.response: 200 OK: Array of {id, user_id, tenant_id, tenant_name, role, created_at, created_by}

api.name: GET /api/v1/roles
api.description: List all available roles with metadata
api.response: 200 OK: Array of {role: RoleEnum, display_name: string, description: string, level: number} sorted by level (1=super_admin first, 5=viewer last)

api.name: GET /api/v1/tenants
api.description: List all tenants (existing endpoint from Story 23)
api.response: 200 OK: Array of {id: UUID, tenant_id: string (VARCHAR), name: string}
api.note: Use tenant.tenant_id (VARCHAR) in role assignment API calls, NOT tenant.id (UUID)

tests.standards: React Testing Library + Jest for unit tests, MSW (Mock Service Worker) for API mocking in integration tests, @testing-library/user-event for user interactions. All tests use async/await patterns. Coverage target: 80%+ for components and hooks. Follow patterns from existing tests in tests/components/users/ and tests/integration/.

tests.ideas: AC-1: Test "Manage Roles" button visibility (shows for super_admin/tenant_admin, hidden for developer/operator/viewer), button click opens modal AC-2: Test modal opens/closes, header displays user name/email, close button works, ESC key closes modal AC-3: Test fetching user roles (loading skeleton appears, data displays in table, error banner with retry), test empty state message AC-4: Test assign role form (tenant dropdown, role dropdown, assign button disabled until both selected, form submission, success toast, optimistic row addition, error rollback for 400 duplicate/403 forbidden) AC-5: Test remove role (confirmation dialog opens, cancel button, confirm button, success toast, optimistic row removal, error rollback for 400 last super_admin/404 not found) AC-6: Test tenant scoping (tenant_admin sees disabled dropdown pre-selected with default_tenant_id, super_admin sees enabled searchable dropdown with all tenants) AC-7: Test role dropdown (displays 5 roles with display_name + description, sorted by level, selection updates form) AC-8: Test optimistic updates (assign adds row immediately before API response, remove removes row immediately, both rollback on error with previous data snapshot) AC-9: Test mobile responsive (modal full-screen < 768px with card layout, modal 600px ≥ 768px with table layout) AC-10: Test loading states (assign button spinner during mutation, remove button spinner, skeleton rows), test error states (API error messages in toasts)
